picks.rationale: A free DAW host plus a dev platform and storefront for AI-powered instruments — the first credible attempt at an app-store layer for plugins, and it ships with free instruments today.

picks.headline: "I'm cancelling my subscription": Suno users slam its V6 update as "muffled, generic, soulless garbage"

picks.rationale: A major promo gatekeeper now rejects fully AI-generated tracks outright — changes what you can pitch to blogs and playlists from this week.

picks.headline: SubmitHub bans AI-generated music from its promotion services

picks.headline: SSL 4K Bundle: Now With sonible AI!
